summary: Backend Software Engineer with over 3 years of professional experience designing RESTful APIs, high-throughput microservices, and robust relational databases using Python and PostgreSQL, achieving proven performance optimizations such as a 38% reduction in p95 query latency.

experience.title: Backend Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and maintained 12+ REST microservices serving over 800 requests per second using Python, FastAPI, and Django.
Led PostgreSQL schema design and comprehensive query optimization, reducing p95 latency by 38% and decreasing database load by 45% via Redis caching.
Implemented Docker containerization for standardized deployment environments.
Integrating RabbitMQ message brokers to handle asynchronous tasks and microservice communication.
